title: Domain experts (LoRA adapters on the served 7B) trained one after another on real data: school maths, planet detection, star classification, cyber questions
requested_by: HiveMind owner (2026-10-24): train several experts one after another over a ten-hour night, 1 to 2 hours each, from astrophysics (planet detection, star classification), school maths to physics, and cyber questions, based on the existing HiveMind Hugging Face mining campaign and Hugging Face datasets

finding_that_shapes_the_design.what: The existing campaign does not train on Hugging Face data. src/hivemind/data/fixtures/polyglot_science_8domain_v1.json holds three short strings per domain, and src/hivemind/data/hf_real_trainer.py states in its own docstring that it fits seeded random targets, fetches no dataset and measures no classification accuracy. Its astrophysics dataset id (MultimodalUniverse/multimodal_universe) and the registry ids for Rust, Solidity and Lean do not resolve on the Hugging Face API (HTTP 401).
finding_that_shapes_the_design.consequence: The campaign supplies subjects and structure only. This run uses real public data with held-out evaluation, and nothing here may be described as a continuation of an earlier measured result.

model.base: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, nf4 for training, LoRA r16 alpha32 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; served as the Q4_K_M GGUF of the router's qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct with llama-server --lora (the path E17 verifies)
model.note: A coder model is the only 7B on the T4 today. Subjects outside code are a test of how far an adapter moves it, not a claim of domain strength.

exoplanet.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP table 'cumulative' (Kepler objects of interest)
exoplanet.licence_as_read: NASA Exoplanet Archive data are public; acknowledgement requested (read the archive's acknowledgement page before publishing)

stars.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP table 'stellarhosts' (observed spectral type from the literature)
stars.licence_as_read: NASA Exoplanet Archive data are public; acknowledgement requested

cyber.source: Trendyol/Trendyol-Cybersecurity-Instruction-Tuning-Dataset (train, first 60 MB, LLM-generated, no verifier) + cais/mmlu computer_security + AI4Sec/cti-bench cti-mcq (eval only)

licence_as_read.cti-bench: cc-by-nc-sa-4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike: evaluation only, nothing redistributed; owner to confirm)

data_notes.exoplanet: Kepler objects of interest, CONFIRMED vs FALSE POSITIVE (CANDIDATE excluded). Split by star. Label-defining columns excluded (koi_fpflag_*, koi_pdisposition, koi_score). Classical reference on the same features (numpy logistic regression): {"accuracy": 0.8233333333333334, "balanced_accuracy": 0.8146815704299071, "n_eval": 600}
data_notes.stars: Observed spectral class of planet-host stars. The held-out set has no O or B stars and 2 A stars, so only F, G, K, M are really tested. Temperature is a feature: the textbook temperature rule scores 0.8265 on this held-out set, so this subject tests the pipeline, not astrophysics.
data_notes.maths: GSM8K gold step-by-step solutions (calculator markup removed); numeric final-answer match. Physics is a TRANSFER test: MMLU high-school, college and conceptual physics (488 questions), eval only. No physics training data with a clear licence and a checkable answer was found (camel-ai/physics is CC-BY-NC and unverified).
data_notes.cyber: Training: Trendyol instruction data (Apache-2.0, LLM-generated, unverified), filtered by a keyword list that drops offensive-tooling requests (pattern in the pack manifest) and by answer length. Evaluation: MMLU computer_security (100) and CTI-Bench MCQ (400, CC-BY-NC-SA, evaluation only, nothing redistributed). Both choices need owner confirmation before the run.

hypotheses.H-maths: The maths adapter raises accuracy on 200 held-out GSM8K problems over the base (same engine, same settings). Accepted only if exact McNemar p < 0.05 two-sided AND the net gain is positive. With 200 items a gain below about 5 to 8 points cannot reach that, so a smaller gain is reported as 'not detected', never as 'improved'.
hypotheses.H-physics-transfer: No claim of gain. The maths adapter is flagged HARM if it is significantly worse than the base on 488 MMLU physics questions (p < 0.05, adapter lower).
hypotheses.H-exoplanet: The adapter beats the base on 600 held-out Kepler objects (exact McNemar p < 0.05, net positive). Against the classical reference the comparison is descriptive (accuracy with Wilson interval); no significance claim, because the reference predictions are not paired.
hypotheses.H-stars: The adapter beats the base on 317 held-out stars (exact McNemar p < 0.05). Reported next to the temperature rule and the majority class; expected to land near the rule.
hypotheses.H-cyber: No gain is expected from LLM-generated, unverified training text. Primary: the adapter is not significantly worse than the base on the pooled 500 questions (HARM flag otherwise); a gain is reported only if p < 0.05.
hypotheses.H-interference: Each adapter, on the first 100 items of every other pack, is not significantly worse than the base (HARM flag otherwise). 100 items detect only large harm (about 8 to 11 points).

minimum_detectable_gain: Exact McNemar, two-sided p < 0.05, computed for discordant-pair shares of 10, 15 and 25 percent: n=100: 8 to 11 points; n=200: 5 to 8; n=317: 4.4 to 6; n=488: 3.1 to 4.9; n=500: 3.2 to 4.6; n=600: 3.0 to 4.3.

controls.negative_control: For every subject a second adapter is trained on the same prompts with the completions dealt out to other prompts (1 epoch, time-capped) and evaluated on the same pack. If it shows a significant GAIN over the base (p < 0.05), the evaluation or the pipeline is contaminated and that subject's result is VOID.
controls.scorer_controls: Unit tests: unparsable replies count as wrong; known McNemar and Wilson values; the orchestrator's failure handling with external calls mocked. Four deliberate breakages were each caught by a test.
controls.determinism: Verified for this engine on the E17 base run (0 of 30 repeats differed, prompt cache off). Not re-checked per pack.
controls.leakage: Each pack asserts no shared key and no identical prompt between train and eval; the exoplanet and star splits put whole stars on one side.

acceptance_before_any_adapter_is_served: An adapter may be offered for serving only if its own pack passes (p < 0.05 gain, control not significant) AND the verified update gate (src/hivemind/swarm/verified_update_gate.py, paired non-regression) returns ACCEPT on the other packs. Otherwise the result is reported and the adapter is not served.

before_the_night: E17 finished and the producer restored with the restore command tested
free disk on the VM data disk at least 2 GB
owner confirms: router offline for about 8 hours, cyber filter and CTI-Bench evaluation-only use
operations.restore: the producer agent is restarted as the last stage regardless of failures; if that stage fails the exit code is 4

schedule_estimate_minutes.note: estimates from the E17 speed (about 1.1 s per 300-token sequence for a 7B in nf4); the trainer time caps protect the night; real timings are written to state.json
schedule_estimate_minutes.maths: train 45 (cap 45) + control 15 + convert/serve 10 + eval own 30 + transfer 15 + control eval 15 = about 130
schedule_estimate_minutes.exoplanet: train 27 + control 15 + 10 + eval 13 + astro 8 + control eval 13 = about 86
schedule_estimate_minutes.stars: train 20 + control 15 + 10 + eval 7 + astro 8 + control eval 7 = about 67
schedule_estimate_minutes.cyber: train 56 (cap 60) + control 15 + 10 + eval 13 + control eval 13 = about 107
schedule_estimate_minutes.total_with_interference: about 7.2 h of the 10 h; the rest is slack

not_claimed: a better astrophysics or cyber model in general
that the experts beat larger models
that a gain on a held-out split transfers to other data
anything about the 20B gpt-oss tier, which is a separate measurement
a Nash or market result: serving is a separate decision
non_monetary: HMT remain points with no cash value.
